tools.name: quote_update_draft
tools.description: Use this when a user provides or corrects ShipMyCar quote details. It returns a stateless draft plus next questions and does not create records, send email, or contact ShipMyCar.

tools.name: quote_get_requirements
tools.description: Use this when a ShipMyCar quote draft needs checking before generation. It only inspects the draft and returns route requirements, enabled services, missing fields, and next questions.

tools.name: quote_generate
tools.description: Use this after the user explicitly confirms a complete ShipMyCar quote draft. Quotes UK domestic transport or EU/international imports to the UK with transport and HMRC estimates only. VIN, DVLA/IVA and exports are disabled. It calculates pricing, writes a private quote continuation/API usage record

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "quote_generate" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use this after the user explicitly confirms a complete ShipMyCar quote draft. It calculates pricing, writes a private quote continuation/API usage record, and returns a continueQuoteUrl. It does not send email or create a public booking." → after: "Use this after the user explicitly confirms a complete ShipMyCar quote draft. Quotes UK domestic transport or EU/international imports to the UK with transport and HMRC estimates only. VIN, DVLA/IVA and exports are disabled. It calculates pricing, writes a private quote continuation/API usage record"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
